name: Hinkelsteinwiese
beschreibung: The campsite Hinkelsteinwiese is located in a valley in Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by mountain meadows and coniferous forests. The site has level pitches for tents and motorhomes with electricity hookups. Sanitary facilities with warm water are available. A small grocery store is on the grounds. From here, hikes into the surrounding mountains can be undertaken. Guests can expect simple accommodation in nature.
